hints.en: Start with base cases F(0)=0 and F(1)=1, then build up
hints.hi: Base cases F(0)=0 aur F(1)=1 se shuru karo, phir upar build karo

hints.en: Use a dp array or just two variables to store previous values
hints.hi: Ek dp array ya sirf do variables use karo previous values store karne ke liye

description.hi: Tum ek seedhi chadh rahe ho jisme n steps hain. Har baar tum 1 ya 2 steps chadh sakte ho. Top tak pahunchne ke kitne alag tarike hain, woh return karo.

explanation.en: There are 8 distinct ways to climb 5 stairs
explanation.hi: 5 seedhiyan chadhne ke 8 alag tarike hain

hints.en: To reach step n, you can come from step n-1 or step n-2
hints.hi: Step n tak pahunchne ke liye step n-1 ya step n-2 se aa sakte ho

hints.en: This is essentially the Fibonacci sequence!
hints.hi: Ye basically Fibonacci sequence hai!

description.en: You are a robber planning to rob houses along a street. Each house has a certain amount of money. You cannot rob two adjacent houses (alarm will trigger). Return the maximum amount of money you can rob.
description.hi: Tum ek chor ho jo ek street ke gharon ko lootne ka plan bana rahe ho. Har ghar mein kuch paisa hai. Do adjacent gharon ko nahi loot sakte (alarm baj jaayega). Maximum kitna paisa loot sakte ho, woh return karo.

hints.hi: Har ghar ke liye decide karo: looto (i-2 ke answer mein add karo) ya skip karo (i-1 ka answer lo)

hints.en: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i])
hints.hi: dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i])

problems.title: Longest Common Subsequence

description.en: Given two strings text1 and text2, return the length of their longest common subsequence. A subsequence is a sequence that can be derived by deleting some (or no) characters without changing the order of remaining characters.
description.hi: Do strings text1 aur text2 diye hain, unki longest common subsequence ki length return karo. Subsequence ek aisi sequence hai jo kuch characters delete karke banti hai bina order badle.

constraints: Strings contain only lowercase English letters

hints.en: Use 2D DP where dp[i][j] = LCS of text1[0..i-1] and text2[0..j-1]
hints.hi: 2D DP use karo jahan dp[i][j] = text1[0..i-1] aur text2[0..j-1] ki LCS

hints.en: If characters match, add 1 to diagonal. Else take max of top or left.
hints.hi: Agar characters match karen, diagonal mein 1 add karo. Warna top ya left ka max lo.

approach.hi: 2D DP: agar chars match karen dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1], warna max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).

description.en: Given n items with weights and values, and a knapsack with capacity W. Each item can be taken at most once. Find the maximum total value that fits in the knapsack.
description.hi: n items diye hain unke weights aur values ke saath, aur ek knapsack hai jiska capacity W hai. Har item sirf ek baar le sakte ho. Maximum total value nikalo jo knapsack mein fit ho sake.

explanation.en: Take items with weight 3 (value 4) and weight 4 (value 5). Total = 9.
explanation.hi: Weight 3 (value 4) aur weight 4 (value 5) wale items lo. Total = 9.

hints.en: For each item, decide: take it or skip it
hints.hi: Har item ke liye decide karo: lo ya skip karo

hints.en: dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-wt[i]] + val[i]) if wt[i] <= w
hints.hi: dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-wt[i]] + val[i]) agar wt[i] <= w

hints.en: dp[i] = minimum coins to make amount i
hints.hi: dp[i] = amount i banane ke liye minimum coins

hints.hi: Har amount ke liye, har coin try karo aur min lo

problems.title: Edit Distance

description.en: Given two strings word1 and word2, return the minimum number of operations required to convert word1 to word2. Allowed operations: Insert a character, Delete a character, Replace a character.
description.hi: Do strings word1 aur word2 diye hain. word1 ko word2 mein convert karne ke liye minimum kitne operations chahiye woh return karo. Allowed operations: Character insert karo, Character delete karo, Character replace karo.

explanation.en: horse -> rorse (replace h with r) -> rose (remove r) -> ros (remove e)
explanation.hi: horse -> rorse (h ko r se replace) -> rose (r remove) -> ros (e remove)

constraints: Strings contain only lowercase English letters

hints.en: dp[i][j] = min operations to convert word1[0..i-1] to word2[0..j-1]
hints.hi: dp[i][j] = word1[0..i-1] ko word2[0..j-1] mein convert karne ke min operations

hints.en: If chars match, dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]. Else min of insert, delete, replace + 1.
hints.hi: Agar chars match karen, dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]. Warna insert, delete, replace ka min + 1.

description.en: Given an array p[] representing dimensions of matrices such that matrix i has dimensions p[i-1] x p[i]. Find the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply the chain of matrices.
description.hi: Ek array p[] diya hai jo matrices ke dimensions represent karta hai, jaise ki matrix i ka dimension p[i-1] x p[i] hai. Matrices ki chain ko multiply karne ke liye minimum scalar multiplications kitni chahiye woh nikalo.

explanation.hi: Optimal parenthesization: ((A1(A2*A3))*A4) se 26000 multiplications aate hain

hints.en: dp[i][j] = min cost to multiply matrices from i to j
hints.hi: dp[i][j] = matrix i se j tak multiply karne ki min cost

hints.en: Try every split point k between i and j: cost = dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] + p[i-1]*p[k]*p[j]
hints.hi: Har split point k try karo i aur j ke beech: cost = dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] + p[i-1]*p[k]*p[j]

problems.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
problems.titleHi: Array ko Barabar Sum Mein Baanto

description.en: Given an integer array nums, determine if you can partition the array into two subsets such that the sum of elements in both subsets is equal. Return true or false.
description.hi: Ek integer array nums diya hai. Kya tum array ko do subsets mein baant sakte ho jinka sum barabar ho? true ya false return karo.

explanation.hi: Partition: [1, 5, 5] aur [11], dono ka sum 11 hai

explanation.en: Cannot partition into equal sum subsets
explanation.hi: Barabar sum wale subsets mein nahi baant sakte

hints.en: If total sum is odd, return false. Otherwise find subset with sum = total/2
hints.hi: Agar total sum odd hai toh false return karo. Warna sum = total/2 wala subset dhundho

hints.en: This reduces to 0/1 knapsack / subset sum problem
hints.hi: Ye 0/1 knapsack / subset sum problem mein convert ho jaata hai
